versions.changelog: Add matrix cross-sell guidance to route Vipshop users toward the right shopping skill.
Sharpen Vipshop positioning around branded discount decisions, stock, and VIP-price tradeoffs.
Security-aligned public release under the original slug with low-sensitivity decision-support scope only.
Browser-commerce workflow upgrade: unified OpenClaw browser profile selection, snapshot/re-snapshot rules, commerce extraction order, and platform-specific live-page guidance.

- Major update: transitioned from a CLI tool to a rich shopping guide format.
- Removed all CLI code and associated files.
- SKILL.md now provides in-depth guidance on flash sale timing, brand navigation, price comparison, sizing, and return policies.
- No dependencies or Python modules required; focuses on best practices and consumer tips for shopping on VIP.com.
- Linked related skills for broader ecommerce support.

Initial release of the VIP (唯品会) CLI skill:

- Search products with optional pagination and caching.
- Login via QR code browser authentication.
- Query ongoing sales events.
- Browse brands by category (women, men, etc).
- All sensitive data stored locally with AES-256 encryption; user consent required on first run.
- Includes privacy commands for viewing, clearing, or exporting encrypted data.
- Uses browser automation with anti-detection measures for secure operation.
